## Title
**The Money Made Simple Toolkit: budget, debt, credit and investing kits (5 guides + 5 spreadsheets)**

## Short description
All five Money Made Simple kits in one download: Bill Cut, 20-Minute Budget, Credit Report Audit, Debt-Free Date Planner, and Start Investing With $100 a Month. $62 separately, $39 together.

## Full description
> Five kits that work together, in the order most people need them:
>
> 1. **The Bill Cut Kit:** find and cut every recurring charge, and lower the bills you keep with call scripts.
> 2. **The 20-Minute Budget:** bills, savings and goals on autopilot; everything else is one weekly spending number.
> 3. **The Credit Report Audit Kit:** pull your reports free, dispute errors with ready letters, freeze your credit.
> 4. **The Debt-Free Date Planner:** up to 10 debts, avalanche or snowball, a real debt-free date, transfer and consolidation checks.
> 5. **Start Investing With $100 a Month:** which account first, what to buy, fees, automation, with calculators.
>
> Plus a **Start Here** map with a 30-day plan that uses all five, and notes on how the spreadsheets feed each other.
>
> **You get:** 5 PDF guides (about 60 pages in all), 5 spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers), all future updates to this edition. One payment, no subscription.
>
> Educational content only, not financial, tax, legal or investment advice.

## Benefit bullets
- Everything in one download, organised in the order to use it.
- $23 less than buying the five kits separately.
- A 30-day plan so you know exactly what to do first.
- Every spreadsheet pre-filled with an example, so nothing starts blank.
